title: The EU Has Orbits, and the UK Fell Out of All of Them
summary: CGP Grey's six-minute explainer of the relationships the UK could have with the EU, based on Barnier's slide, shown as orbits of different closeness. It explains why the UK's red lines ruled out the closer options.
why: HN recommends it as the quickest clear overview of the Brexit options, though later commenters note it predates the final outcome.
